resources.string: A keyboard app for phones with a real keyboard, tuned for the Unihertz Titan 2 Elite and built on Pastiera by PalSoftware. The next pages cover what\'s worth knowing, and what\'s new.
Set it up in one step

Recommended settings are the configuration Flux Keyboard is tuned with: modifiers, suggestions, spacing and LEDs, plus the Titan 2 Elite\'s trackpad and compact bar on that phone. Matters of taste come next, under Your choices.
Change anything afterwards in Settings.
After an update, any newly recommended settings are offered once, showing each change from your value to the new one.
On other phones, the Titan 2 Elite\'s trackpad and compact bar stay as they are.
Apply recommended settings (%1$d changes)
Recommended settings are on
Couldn\'t apply the recommended settings.
Emoji, symbols, kaomoji and GIFs
The emoji key opens emoji, SYM the symbols: pages you turn with Q and P, starting on your recents.
Tap the emoji key (Right Shift by default) to open the picker. Held with Ctrl, it still works as Shift.
GIFs: L on the emoji recents page, or the picker\'s GIF tab. Keep favourites and recents.
Kaomoji: L on the symbols recents page. Search them by mood, action or name, like lenny face or table flip.
Emoji layer profiles (chatting, work, social…) can follow the app you\'re in.
Choose the emoji key
Type faster
Small things that save keystrokes.
Ctrl+Shift+Q, W or E picks the left, middle or right suggestion.
Ctrl+Z undoes what you typed in any app, and Ctrl+Y redoes it. Backspace right after an auto-correction undoes it, and Shift+Backspace deletes forwards.
Just copied something? It\'s offered as a chip in the next text field, with tracking and redirects stripped from links.

The spell checker underlines typos in every app, with Gboard\'s corrections joining the suggestions when it\'s the phone\'s spell checker, and password managers show their chips in the suggestion bar.
Spell checker settings
Works with your apps
The same keys do the same things everywhere.
App shortcuts: Ctrl+F, Ctrl+N and friends work the same in every app.
Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a new line in every app. In email and note apps, Enter adds a new line and Ctrl+Enter sends. Your installed apps are listed so you can change any of them.
Exact typing: nothing rewrites what you type in terminals, code editors or AI chats.
Terminal mode gives Termux a real Ctrl, hides the microphone and keeps the keyboard out of the way.
Open App shortcuts
Done
Close
Your choices
Matters of taste the recommended settings leave to you. Change any of them later in Settings.
More typing settings
Auto-correct as you type
Fix typos when you press Space. Off, suggestions still show.
Double Space types a full stop
Two spaces end the sentence with \". \".
Emoji suggestions
An emoji for the word you\'re typing, in the suggestion bar.
GIF search
A GIF tab in the emoji picker and a GIF key on the emoji layer (searches online, through KLIPY).
The emoji key opens the emoji layer
Emoji on the letter keys, one key each. Off, it opens the emoji picker instead.
Colours from your wallpaper
The keyboard takes its colours from the wallpaper, light or dark with the system.
Extras to set up
These need a permission or another app, so they start off. Set them up now, or later in Settings.
On
One-time codes
Codes from your notifications, offered as a chip to fill in. Needs notification access.

Codes from your notifications, offered as a chip to fill in. Android blocks notification access for apps installed from a file until you allow restricted settings: the button shows you how, step by step, and opens App info.
Turn on
Niagara search as the quick launcher
The quick launcher opens Niagara\'s search instead of the built-in one, and Back takes you back to your app.
Use Niagara
Use the built-in one
Apps that handle the keyboard themselves
In apps like Termux:X11 and Niagara Launcher (both hidden by default), the keyboard stays out of sight and leaves every key to the app. Its status LEDs there need the accessibility service.
Choose these apps
Tap SYM or the emoji key once and the next key types its symbol or emoji, without opening a screen (turn them on in Modifiers & SYM and in Emoji, symbols & GIFs).
On the trackpad, swipe left, up or right to pick a suggestion, and down to delete a word (Trackpad gestures).
Choose which kinds of text field start with a capital: messages, names and addresses by default.
Each app can keep the language you last typed in there.

The quick launcher (SYM + Space, from any app) opens apps, their own shortcuts (\"New message\"), Flux Keyboard\'s New and Search for the apps it knows, your Termux scripts, and whatever you add: long-press an app there to add one.
Apps that open with their search bar focused can keep the keyboard bar hidden until you type.
Make it yours
Change what keys type, and how the keyboard looks.
Edit any layout in the app: tap a key to change what it types, then save, copy or export it.
Each status LED can have its own colour, and a fifth LED shows the emoji key.
Colours from your wallpaper or a theme of your own, or a picture behind the keyboard: drag and zoom it into place on a preview, and its colours can set the keys\'.
Choose the menu bar\'s buttons and their order.
Status LED colours

One-time codes and the keyboard\'s LEDs in hidden-keyboard apps need notification access or the accessibility service, which Android blocks for apps installed from a file until you allow restricted settings once.
Show me how
Punctuation spacing: choose which marks take a space after them, and which never have one before.
On the Titan 2 Elite, the LEDs can follow the screen\'s rounded bottom corners on two rails, the same length on every page (Titan 2 Elite settings).
Updates download inside the app and install when you say so.
Termux scripts in the quick launcher
Your Termux:Widget scripts and tasks (~/.shortcuts) run straight from the quick launcher. Allow Flux Keyboard to run commands in Termux, then set Termux up with the command below.
Swipes go to the keyboard while you type

While a text field is being typed in, the keyboard takes the trackpad\'s swipes before the app, so they pick suggestions and don\'t scroll the page. Scroll assistant has to be on for the app in front, or the phone passes no swipes on at all. Needs the accessibility service and Android 14 or later.
Set up Termux for the keyboard

Copies a command and opens Termux: paste it there (long press, Paste) and press Enter. It lets other apps run commands (allow-external-apps, which the quick launcher\'s scripts need) and removes the extra-keys row and its text box, which a phone with keys like the Titan 2 Elite doesn\'t need. Pasting it again changes nothing.
Copy the command and open Termux
Command copied: paste it into Termux and press Enter
Allow running Termux commands
It learns as you go: words you type often, and the emails and phone numbers you type yourself (never in Incognito typing).

The emoji layer and the symbols open on what you used last, with search on A. Q and P turn through every emoji by category, or common symbols, arrows, maths, currency and more. Whatever you use joins the recents.
Hold an emoji, on its key or on screen, for its skin tones. Choose a default skin tone below.
Key shortcuts for private mode (Incognito typing and Offline mode together) and for selecting from the cursor: set them in Customize keys.
Keyboard light and shortcuts (Shizuku)

With Shizuku running, the Titan 2\'s keyboard light follows the screen and its brightness, or flashes for notifications, and shortcuts can force-stop the app in front, toggle Battery Saver or cut an app off the network. No root needed.
Open Shizuku extras
Keyboard themes: the theme page shows which theme is in use in light and dark mode, and sets it with a tap.
Keyboard swipes per app

Turn Scroll assistant on for every app in the phone\'s settings (select all apps there), then choose here where keyboard swipes may scroll. Flux Keyboard keeps them from the other apps through the accessibility service (Android 14 and later). While you type, they always go to the keyboard.
